content.short: UR combines a Swiss IBAN, seven fiat currencies and stablecoins in a single account.
content.description: UR offers a single account holding both stablecoins and fiat, with a Swiss IBAN and support for seven currencies, aimed at people who need to hold and move both without treating them as separate systems. A real IBAN is the meaningful detail, since it makes the account usable for ordinary salary and invoice payments.
